resume_preferences: Always use the user's original LaTeX template and preserve formatting, margins, spacing, headings, header and commands unless asked to redesign.
One page exactly when requested; fill a full page, neither shorter nor longer.
Use a short, crisp summary and simple, direct English.
Select only relevant experience and 2-4 strongest projects for the JD; don't include everything on every resume.
Do not list ChatGPT as a resume tool; don't highlight HTML.
Use GitHub as the link label instead of Case Study when requested; portfolio link is sufficient in header.
Do not invent numbers, scope, outcomes, dates, skills, employment, or application status.
Use RAC thinking only if it naturally improves a bullet; candidate later asked not to force RAC labels into project bullets.
